description: Source code for the DataFrameWriter class in Apache Spark, providing methods to write Dataset objects to external storage systems with various options and configurations.

classes.name: DataFrameWriter
classes.description: A class providing methods to configure and execute write operations for a Dataset in Spark.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Sets the save mode for the write operation, either via SaveMode or String.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Sets a key-value option for the write operation.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Sets multiple options for the write operation.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Specifies columns to partition the data by.

methods.name: bucketBy
methods.description: Specifies bucketing details for the write operation.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Specifies columns to sort the data by.

methods.name: clusterBy
methods.description: Specifies columns to cluster the data by.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the Dataset to the specified path.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the Dataset with default options.

methods.name: executeWriteOperation
methods.description: Internal method to build and execute the write command.

methods.name: insertInto
methods.description: Inserts data into a specified table.

methods.name: saveAsTable
methods.description: Saves the Dataset as a table.
